definitions: An involuntary, rapid, and often uncontrollable shaking or trembling of one's leg, typically due to nervousness, anxiety, or excitement.
A visible and often rhythmic tremor in the leg, resembling the rapid up-and-down motion of a sewing machine needle.
examples: Before the big presentation, he had a serious case of sewing machine leg.
Her sewing machine leg started up as soon as she saw the roller coaster.
The cold made him shiver, giving him a sewing machine leg.
